sentences.en: We criticized the photographer for not rescuing the child first.
sentences.zh: 我们批评这位摄影师没有先去救那个孩子。

sentences.en: Every dumbass with a camera thinks he is a photographer.
sentences.zh: 每个拿着相机的人都以为自己是摄影师。

sentences.en: Her acute observation skills make her a very suitable photographer.
sentences.zh: 她敏锐的观察力使她成为一位非常合适的摄影师。
